# laya-go defend prompt v1 golden request

`request.json` is laya-go's `games/defend/prompt/testdata/v1_sample_request.json` (laya-go branch `defend`, commit `05a4741`). The contract test builds the same state from a fake bot: chainmail helmet and iron chestplate (8 armour), a shield in the off hand, a bow, an iron sword, 12 arrows in two stacks, a golden apple; a zombie at E2 N2 and a skeleton at W12 S4 (plus a far zombie and a cow, left out).
